Name: More Prismatic Stardew
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
This mod adds lots of [color=#FF0000]r[/color][color=#FFDA00]a[/color][color=#48FF00]i[/color][color=#00FF91]n[/color][color=#0091FF]b[/color][color=#9A6CE2]o[/color][color=#FF00DA]w[/color] things! They are generally configurable.

[size=5][u]Things In This Mod:
[/u][/size]
[b]Fashion Sense Clothing:[/b][list]
[*]Shirts: Ace, Aro, Bi, Gay, Genderqueer, Lesbian, Nonbinary, Pan, and Trans pride shirts in both fem and masc versions, plus heart version. Plus prismatic heart shirt and gradient tops! (30 shirts total)
[*]Pants: Gradient genie pants and skirt (to match gradient top)
[*]Accessories: 7 types of earrings plus a rainbow fan
[*]Hat: Rainbow crown hat
[/list]
[b]Crops, Furniture, and Machine via DGA:
[/b][list]
[*]Two new crops (grow Rainbow Rose in summer and Rainbow Lights in winter)
[*]Flower Jar for making Rainbow Jelly (from Rainbow Rose) and Rainbow Paradise (from Coconut + Rainbow Rose), unlocked at Farming Level 4
[*]Furniture (growable or at Hat Mouse in summer, or in Catalogue): Rainbow Heart Lights, Rainbow String of Lights, Rainbow Wall Decoration
[/list]
[b]New Mine Rocks via Custom Resource Clumps:
[/b][list]
[*]Two new resource clumps, find randomly in the mines, break for nice rewards (around 1-2% spawn rate)
[/list]
[b]Various Retextures via DGA and CP:
[/b][list]
[*]Pearl, Golden Pumpkin, Rainbow Shell, Mermaid Pendant, Galaxy Sword static retextures (configurable on/off in DGA pack)
[*]Maki Roll, Mine Crystals, and Qi Gem animated prismatic retextures (configurable on/off in DGA pack)
[*]Since the Maki Roll is rainbow now, it's now a Rainbow Roll (configurable on/off in CP pack)
[*]Since the Golden Pumpkin is no longer simply golden, it's now a Prismatic Pumpkin ﻿(configurable on/off in CP pack)
[*]There are some animated Pearl and Golden Pumpkin retextures that are commented out due to BugsTM but you can put them back if you want and have the know-how to edit the jsons
[/list]
[size=5][u]How to Use This Mod:
[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install all needed prerequisites (SMAPI, Content Patcher, Custom Resource Clumps, Dynamic Game Assets, SpaceCore, Fashion Sense)
[*]Move this mod into your Mods folder with the other mods
[*]Launch game
[*]Configure config.json as desired or use GMCM to configure
[/list]
Thank you to Calcite for the winter lights crop idea, and to various people in the Stardew Modmaker Community for advice!
